notes: Regenerate the native content with public Bifrost 0.14.0 release-candidate source c11a13ffa03ebea154f587b899954e412b5b871e, so generated productions use the engine's current semantic-model schema 17 and the 0.14.0 installer verifies the bundle. This is a minor release because it also carries the source and native changes merged since 0.4.0: the Go os procedure-contract and declaration outputs activate on the corrected go-stdlib ecosystem at pack version 2.0.0, and the source catalog adds the CPython 3.13.5 runtime-base and bounded Python object declaration models and the PHP and C++ network-effect boundary models. Jobs and recipes are unchanged from 0.4.0; the new source-only models are not selected by the release recipe and are not native additions. Fresh generation, artifact integrity, per-run completeness and consumer behavior remain separate qualification requirements.
